name: io.github.blackoutsecure/linuxserver-mcp-registry
title: LinuxServer.io Image Registry MCP
description: Community MCP server for discovering LinuxServer.io images, auditing Docker usage against LinuxServer.io documentation-derived conventions, and searching open and closed image requests before preparing new request drafts.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional GitHub token used only for richer GitHub Discussions search and authenticated request lookups. The server must not automatically comment, react, or plus-one discussions.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.sponsorship: Sponsored by Blackout Secure for the LinuxServer.io community
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.project_scope: Community registry, image discovery, open and closed image request search, image request preparation, and documentation-derived audits. Not an official LinuxServer.io certification.
